newsitem.title: INDIA: India 95/96 foodgrains output drops to 190.4 mln t.
newsitem.headline: India 95/96 foodgrains output drops to 190.4 mln t.

text.p: India's total foodgrains output in 1995/96 (April-March) is likely to show a marginal drop at 190.4 million tonnes against the peak of 191.1 million in the previous year, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said in its 1995/96 (July-June) annual report released on Friday.
"The production of major non-foodgrain crops such as oilseeds, cotton, tea and coffee recorded substantial improvement during 1995/96," the report said.
Total procurement of foodgrains during 1995/96 was 22.3 million tonnes against the 25.3 million tonnes in the previous year, it said.

"The off-take of foodgrains during the year picked up considerably due to substantial spurt in open market sales (including exports), higher demand from the public distribution system and higher use on account of various employment/welfare schemes," it said.
